small.purpose: Navigation state, source, version, and operation status.

nativeQt.runtimeCompatibility: Visual checks do not establish gameplay or Linux runtime compatibility.
nativeQt.fontPolicy: Qt application font; platform metrics. Offscreen fallback is test support only.

controlTokens.navigationFocus: Inset dashed outline: focus token when selected, sidebar-muted otherwise.

components.name: Primary action
components.state: Prominent for install/update, game discovery before setup, and save/apply; lighter hover, muted disabled, visible focus.

components.name: Secondary action
components.state: Neutral hover and pressed fills; Enabled/Disabled activation uses green checked text/border.

components.name: Native field
components.state: Deep amber focus; disabled warm surface; SVG combo/spin arrows.

components.name: Library navigation
components.state: Amber selected row, charcoal hover, icon/name/status, inset dashed keyboard focus.

components.name: Game location
components.state: Game path, browse/discovery actions, explicit loader state.

components.name: Content tabs
components.state: Settings; conditional Keybindings and Images/Videos. Selected amber underline; hover warm surface.

components.name: Image preparation
components.state: Labelled empty canvas; transparency checkerboard; footer apply requires current valid preview.

assets.paintedIcons: 24px line icons, 1.7px rounded strokes, rendered at device pixel ratio 2

behavior.scrolling: Forms/media scroll while the mod header, save/apply footer, progress, and operation status persist.
behavior.accessibility: Label buddies, accessible names, text states, native keyboard behavior, and visible focus.
behavior.progress: Qt indeterminate progress animation; no custom motion tokens.

nativeQt.previewFormat: Native widget metadata and source-backed tokens; no HTML/CSS replicas or fabricated web/iOS platform declaration.

narrative.overview: A charcoal library rail anchors a white workspace. Warm amber gives selection and available primary actions a clear visual identity; compact, labelled native controls keep attention on the selected mod and its actual state. English copy uses familiar desktop verbs.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent charcoal navigation with amber selection.
A compact game panel and selected-mod actions above scrolling content.
Separate preferences, keybindings, and capability-dependent media preparation.
Visible keyboard focus and persistent save/apply feedback.

rules.name: Visible State
rules.body: Pair color with explicit text, selection, focus, or control state.

rules.name: Persistent Action
rules.body: Keep saving and applying a prepared image accessible while content scrolls.

dos: **Do** reuse the source-backed Qt tokens, line-icon family, and native keyboard behavior.
**Do** keep installation, enabled, unsaved, and error states explicit in text.
**Do** preserve readable paths, labelled controls, persistent actions, and visible focus at checked desktop sizes.
donts: **Don't** describe web breakpoints, iOS components, or HTML replicas as implemented native UI.
**Don't** infer gameplay or Linux runtime compatibility from visual and offscreen checks.
